research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: AnyVision Interactive Technologies Ltd. is focused on enhancing object detection and face recognition technologies. Their R&D efforts include applying adaptive class thresholds to improve ML models for object detection, ensuring accurate feature vector labeling from images. Additionally, they are developing methods to increase face recognition reliability using drone-mounted sensors, involving adaptive drone positioning for target identification. These advancements aim to bolster real-time threat detection capabilities, aligning with their mission to protect individuals and assets.

about_short_description.short_description: Oosto assists enterprises in protecting their customers, guests, and employees by identifying security and safety threats in real-time.

product.name: Oosto Protect
product.description: An edge-to-cloud video analytics solution providing real-time person of interest alerting and action detection such as fighting, falling, running, and pattern anomalies.

product.name: Oosto OnWatch
product.description: A real-time facial recognition system that identifies persons of interest in crowds and challenging conditions to support security monitoring and investigations.

product.name: Oosto OnAccess
product.description: A touchless access control solution using facial recognition and liveness detection to authorize entry and prevent unauthorized access to secure areas.

product.name: Oosto OnPatrol
product.description: A solution for monitoring and securing perimeters and restricted zones by detecting unauthorized access and suspicious behaviors in real time.

product.name: Oosto Edge Options
product.description: Edge computing solutions embedding Vision AI neural networks into smart cameras and near-edge devices for real-time video analytics and facial recognition.
